note: Salon-side iPhone news. The iOS app carries the salon screens (ios/SafeBeauty/Features/Provider: requests with accept/decline, calendar, income, messages). Facts checked 2026-09-24: iOS live on the App Store (Afghanistan storefront only, since 2026-09-21, app-store/metadata.md) and Android on Google Play (since 2026-08-28) — the generator prints both store names in the footer; safebeauty.web.app/get stays the one printed link and sends each phone to its own store. Salons are in Kabul only — no second city, no count. No promotion running. Every salon, name, price and time on a screen is the invented demo world from marketing/demo/ — nothing real.

fa.headline: سالن‌تان را از آیفون هم اداره کنید
fa.body: درخواست‌ها، تقویم و پیام‌ها — در App Store و Google Play، هر دو.

ps.headline: خپل سالون له آیفون څخه هم اداره کړئ
ps.body: غوښتنې، تقویم او پیغامونه — په App Store او Google Play دواړو کې.
